_help: Live election results pages (/results/<slug>). Each election reads an official results portal. Change anything here, or on /admin/results (that overrides this file without a new deploy). enabled: false = the page shows 'results will appear here on counting day'. window: the page and the reader are only active between these times (India time). pollSeconds: how often the portal is asked (the portal itself refreshes every 120). expectedSeats: the known number of seats; a different number stops the update. keyContests: seats (or parts of seat names, e.g. 'Ward 27') that get their own social post when declared. social: automatic Facebook and Instagram posts for big updates; maxPerDay is the most per network in 24 hours.
